ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low high-to-low intensity ratio across the visible ventral surface; pixels are predominantly low-intensity (black) due to silhouetting, with high-intensity (white) pixels restricted to the extreme distal margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow U-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 125 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged profile across the continuous trailing edge; characterized by numerous sharp peaks and deep valleys from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge, curving upward and outward toward elevated distal vertices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white pixels located at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, forming irregular circular groupings.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular topography and white pixel accumulation on the distal tips, indicating extensive calcification or scarring relative to the smooth silhouette of the main fluke body.
